verdicts.reason: A: the full-height maroon panel keeps the original's centred-panel structure and holds the text block cleanly. But 'MARKETING' runs almost to the panel's edges, 'Join WADE team' has wide, loose word gaps, and the X, slash and circle accents now sit on the busy photo (the X lands on the hands) instead of framing the panel. B: the panel is narrower and stops at an arbitrary height short of the bottom edge, so it looks like a floating, cut-off box. 'MARKETING' nearly touches both sides of the panel, there is a lopsided gap between 'WADE' and 'team', and the corner accents are scattered over the photo just as in A.
